strings.note0: Sapanca is 1.5 hours from Istanbul (by motorway or high-speed train to Arifiye). Get around the lake by car or bike. Maşukiye and Kartepe are 20 minutes away.
strings.note1: The Kartepe ski season runs from December to March; snow tyres are compulsory and the cable car closes in wind.
strings.note2: Trout, spread-style breakfast, ıslama köfte (in Adapazarı) and chestnuts are local specialities.
strings.note3: Bungalow stays are Sapanca's signature; they cost half as much on weekdays.
strings.note4: The Kartepe summit is 10°C cooler in summer, so bring a cardigan.
strings.note5: The lakeside walking path is 5 km long; morning mist makes for great photos.
